verdict.rationale: Mistral documents a dedicated API endpoint for programmatic catalog discovery — 'List Models' (GET /v1/models) and 'Retrieve Model' — directly supporting agent enumeration of the live model catalog, alongside a documented model lifecycle page explaining stages for choosing/retiring models. Missing for 10: independent hands-on confirmation that GET /v1/models works as documented (community evidence is silent on this specific endpoint) and no explicit OpenAPI schema was found (the openapi.json probe 404'd).
